units.source_text: 头中将看看藤式部丞，说道：“你一定有好听的话儿，讲点给大家听听吧。”

en.t: The Captain looked over at Fuji no Shikibu no Jo and said, "You must have some interesting stories; tell us one."

units.source_text: 式部丞答道：“像我这样微不足道的人，有什么话儿可讲给你们听呢？”

en.t: Shikibu no Jo replied, "What could someone as insignificant as I possibly have to tell you?"

units.source_text: 头中将认真起来，连声催促：“快讲，快讲！”

en.t: The Captain became serious and urged him again and again, "Tell us, tell us!"

units.source_text: 式部丞说：“那么教我讲些什么呢？”

en.t: Shikibu no Jo said, "Then what would you have me talk about?"
